note: Alberta Parks campground at Aspen Beach on the south shore of Gull Lake, about 18 km west of Lacombe via Hwy 12 and 12A, with its own entrance; Lakeview Campground is the park's other campground. Treed loops close to the Ebeling Beach day use (sandy beach, playground). Check in at the permit booth on arrival. --Claude
